title: UC8 loan 8 period-3 schedule interest (Tier-D MNT replay)
_note: Parity vector transcribing ONE period's interest of UC8 loan 8 from the Tier-D MNT replay of LoanRepaymentSchedule.feature (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits; product LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INTEREST_DECL_BAL_SARP_EMI_360_30_NO_INT_RECALC_MULTIDISB_PARTIAL_PERIOD). request.schedule transcribes the outstanding principal the period accrues on, periods[2].principalLoanBalanceOutstanding 436.66 -> "43666" minor units, annualInterestRate 12.0 -> 12, and the terms' declared day basis daysInYearType.id 360 / daysInMonthType.id 30. expect.interest_minor transcribes the period's observed interestDue 4.37 -> "437" minor units. The observed 4.37 is NOT a HALF_UP/HALF_EVEN tie (436.66*12*30/(100*360) = 437), so this vector corroborates the interest cell but does not discriminate the rounding mode (the pinned LN-L06 cell does). period 2 (2025-02-01..2025-03-01) straddles the 200.00 tranche dated 2025-02-15, so its observed interestDue 7.70 is a BLEND and is REFUSED. Period 3 accrues on the constant 436.66 and is transcribed. Nothing was computed by this promotion.
